source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Barcelona reportedly receives around €65 million per year from their deal with Spotify.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: This season, Barcelona has entered a five-year sleeve sponsorship deal with Midea (shirt sponsor of Sevilla last season).

source.name: FC Barcelona Foundation, The Barca Foundation logo to appear on the back of the shirt for the first time
source.quote: as it will be the first time that the men's first team wears the Barça Foundation logo on the back of its shirt
source.note: Fundacio FC Barcelona replaces UNHCR/ACNUR on the back; 2Playbook (2026-08-10) confirms: 'En la parte trasera de la camiseta figurará la Fundació FC Barcelona, en sustitución de ACNUR.'

summary: Spotify (front), Midea (sleeve) and the Fundacio FC Barcelona (back) on the 2026-27 home shirt.
